reasons: Lake identity is verified for Alderman v. United States, U.S. Supreme Court, decided 1969-03-24.

Lake treatment field_i_validity is good_law as of 2026-06-30; no confirmed progeny edge in the disclosed record overrules or supersedes Alderman itself.
residual_risks: Progeny derivation flags audit_needed and cap_hit, but disclosed edges are proposed/mentioned rather than confirmed negative treatment.

reasons: Lens B does not adjudicate support fidelity, but the treatment record preserves the personal-rights standing rule as good law.
Lake scope_note says the personal-rights standing rule remains good law and that Rakas recast the inquiry while reaffirming Alderman's core principle.
residual_risks: Support/holding accuracy is outside lens B and not independently attacked here.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: For modern currency, keep the Rakas caveat close to the holding: standing is now often framed as a substantive Fourth Amendment merits inquiry.

residual_risks: Whether Key — Anchor is the best editorial role for the Standing to Challenge a Search home is outside lens B.

defect.problem: The core good_law treatment survives, but treatment metadata carries as_of_content 1969-03-10 even though the disclosed identity/frontmatter gives the decision date as 1969-03-24. If as_of_content is meant to date the authority/content status, it predates the decision and needs correction or definition.
defect.proposed_fix: Retain good_law/as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, but correct or document as_of_content so it does not appear to predate the decision.

reasons: Lake treatment field_i_validity is good_law as of 2026-06-30 and the scope_note matches the page's Rakas caveat.

residual_risks: Treatment derivation reports audit_needed/cap_hit and many proposed negative-event candidates; the disclosed record resolves them only as proposed/mentioned, so a future treatment audit could refine the status.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Add a short note that negative-looking progeny entries are only proposed/mentioned in the lake record, if this page exposes treatment provenance.
